candidates.title: Patron characteristic grouping
candidates.statement: The system shall allow queries and reports to be limited or grouped by patron characteristics including age range, zip code, county of residence, home branch, patron type, and preferred language.
candidates.source_quote: Queries and reports can be limited or grouped by various patron characteristics, including: - age range - zip code - county of residence - home branch - patron type - preferred language

candidates.title: Inactive patrons report
candidates.statement: The system shall generate a list of patrons with no circulation or electronic activity in the last X days, where X is configurable, and the list shall be configurable by scope (System, Home Library, County, etc.).
candidates.source_quote: The system should generate a list of patrons with no circulation or electronic activity in the last X days (X configurable). The list should be configurable to System, Home Library, County, etc.

candidates.title: Transaction history retention
candidates.statement: The system shall maintain transaction history records for X days, where X is configurable.
candidates.source_quote: Transaction history is maintained for X days (X is configurable).

candidates.title: Aggregate transaction data retention
candidates.statement: The system shall maintain monthly and annual aggregate transaction information indefinitely.
candidates.source_quote: Monthly and annual aggregate information is maintained indefinitely.

candidates.title: Transaction grouping and querying
candidates.statement: The system shall allow transactions to be grouped by hour, terminal, branch, and system and shall allow querying either across all transaction types or filtered by transaction type (e.g., check-ins, check-outs, fines collected, patron registrations).
candidates.source_quote: Transactions can be grouped by hour, terminal, branch, and system. Transactions include check-ins, check-outs, fines collected, patron registrations, etc., and can be queried by all transactions or by type of transaction.

candidates.title: Check-in type counting
candidates.statement: The system shall count check-ins individually and cumulatively by type, including book-drop, by terminal, and by user or self-service.
candidates.source_quote: The system counts all types of check-in individually and cumulatively: - book-drop - by terminal - by user or self-service

candidates.title: Check-out type counting
candidates.statement: The system shall count check-outs individually and cumulatively by type, including staff check-out, self check-out, staff renewal, self checkout renewal, online renewal, and OPAC renewal.
candidates.source_quote: The system counts all types of check-out individually and cumulatively: - staff check-out - self check-out - staff renewal - self checkout renewal - online renewal - OPAC renewal

candidates.title: Hold request source counting
candidates.statement: The system shall count hold requests and record how each hold was placed (e.g., at a staff desk, at a public computer inside the library, or remotely).
candidates.source_quote: The system counts all hold requests, including how the hold was placed: - at a staff desk - at a public computer inside the library - remotely

candidates.title: Transactions report scopes
candidates.statement: The system shall generate transaction reports (holds placed, holds filled, check-outs) scoped per patron, per library, per selected group of libraries, per system, and per county.
candidates.source_quote: The system can generate a report of transactions (holds placed, holds filled, and check-outs) per patron, per library, per selected group of libraries, per system, per county.

candidates.title: Per-patron transaction counts
candidates.statement: The system shall display the number of check-outs and placed holds per patron in transaction reports.
candidates.source_quote: The system displays the number of check-outs and placed holds per patron.

candidates.title: Hold subtotals by type
candidates.statement: The system shall subtotal holds by type (for example: active, frozen, and frozen-until) in reports.
candidates.source_quote: Holds are subtotaled by type, e.g., active, frozen, and frozen-until holds.

candidates.title: Value of items report
candidates.statement: The system shall generate reports of the monetary value of items (based on item record data) for the entire collection or for selectable portions (e.g., status longoverdue, all DVDs in children's collection).
candidates.source_quote: The system can generate a report of the value of items (based on data in item record) in the entire collection or a portion. Example: ... value of all items with status of longoverdue, or value of all DVDs in children's collection

candidates.title: Accounting and auditing compliance
candidates.statement: The system shall ensure all reports and data archiving comply with standard accounting practice and applicable state, county, and municipal auditing requirements.
candidates.source_quote: All reports and data archiving must comply with standard accounting practice and state, county, and municipal auditing requirements.

candidates.title: Attach financial transactions to records
candidates.statement: The system shall attach fines, charges, waivers, and ecommerce transactions to patron and item records.
candidates.source_quote: Fines, charges, waivers, and ecommerce transactions are attached to patron and item records.

candidates.title: Track waived fines and payments by library
candidates.statement: The system shall track fines waived and payments made per library.
candidates.source_quote: System tracks fines waived and payments made per library.

candidates.title: Editable financial information
candidates.statement: The system shall allow financial information to be updated easily by authorized staff.
candidates.source_quote: Financial information can be updated easily.

candidates.title: Query patron balances threshold
candidates.statement: The system shall allow a staff user to query patron accounts with balances greater than X dollars, where X is configurable.
candidates.source_quote: As an example, a staff user can easily query patron accounts with balances greater than X dollars.

candidates.title: Financial reports set
candidates.statement: The system shall provide financial reports including patron account balances by patron/home library/system; fines and charges accrued by time period and by type of charge; fines waived by time period and branch; and payments made by time period and payment method.
candidates.source_quote: The system provides financial reports including: - patron account balances by patron, home library, and system - fines and charges accrued per time period ... and per type of charge ... - fines waived per time period and per branch - payments made per time period and per payment method

candidates.title: Financial audit trail ledger
candidates.statement: The system shall maintain a ledger of patron payments that records which charges payments are applied to to facilitate reconciliation.
candidates.source_quote: The system maintains a ledger of patron payments, including which charges payments are applied to, to facilitate reconciliation.

candidates.title: Circulation report types
candidates.statement: The system shall provide predefined circulation reports including Check in Count; Checkout Count; Items overdue by X days; Circulation Count by Circ Modifier, Cat1, and Cat2; Renewals Count; Non-Cat Count; Circulation Count total; Circulation Count by Dewey, Shelving Location, MARC, Circ Location broken down by Patron County and Home Library; and Circulation Count by Age Demographic.
candidates.source_quote: CIRCULATION REPORTS: - Check in Count - Checkout Count (includes checkouts only) - Items overdue by X days ... - Circulation Count by Circ Modifier, Cat1, and Cat2 ... - Circulation Count by Shelving Location ... - Circulation Count by Circ Location broken down by Patron County - Circulation Count by Circ Location broken down by Patron Home Library - Circulation Count by Age Demographic

candidates.title: Items report types
candidates.statement: The system shall provide predefined items reports including Items Added Count, Items Deleted Count, List of Items Added, Items Edited Count, Items Count, Lists by Fines Stopped Reason, Items Currently Checked Out, Items more than XX days overdue, Items marked longoverdue, Lists by Total Use Count thresholds (weeding), Last Copy Report, Lists by Creation Date Range, Lists with status Missing, Items In Transit by sending and destination library, Claims returned, Long Overdue lists, Weeding report (date of last circulation and number of circs), Lists with XXX in bib record, Age of collection by call number or shelving location, Price value of collection by call number or shelving location, and Items to be Converted (batch converting items from one status to another).
candidates.source_quote: ITEMS REPORTS: - Items Added Count - Items Deleted Count - List of Items Added - Items Edited Count - Items Count - List of Items by Fines Stopped Reason - Items Currently Checked Out - Items more than XX days overdue ... - Items marked longoverdue by system ... - List of Items with a > Total Use Count ... - Weeding report ... - Items to be Converted (batch converting items from one status to another)

candidates.title: Bibliographic record reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide bibliographic (bib) record reports including Bib Records Count, Bib Records Edited Count, Bib Records Added by user by library Count, Bib Records with No Volumes attached, and Bib Records missing specific MARC fields.
candidates.source_quote: BIB RECORDS REPORTS: - Bib Records Count - Bib Records Edited Count - Bib Records Added by user by library Count - Bib Records with No Volumes attached - Bib Records missing specific MARC fields

candidates.title: Patron reports set
candidates.statement: The system shall provide patrons reports including Patron Count, Patron Added Count by Month, New Patron Count by Demographic Category, Patron Count by Age Demographic, by County, by County/City/Zip, by Home Library, by Profile Group, by survey answer; lists of patrons by survey answer; Voter Survey Responses County by Week; Lists by Expiration Date; Lists of BARRED patrons; Lists of patrons with inactive status; Lists of staff accounts with date of last password change and account expiration; and Lists of patrons with specific wording in notes.
candidates.source_quote: PATRONS REPORTS: - Patron Count - Patron Added Count by Month - New Patron Count ... - Patron Count by Age Demographic - Patron Count by County - Patron Count by County, City, and Zip Code - Patron Count by Home Library - Patron Count by Profile Group - Patron Count by survey answer - List of patrons by survey answer - Voter Survey Responses County by Week - List of Patrons by Expiration Date - List of patrons who are BARRED - List of Patrons with inactive status - List of Staff Accounts with date of last password change and account expiration - List of Patrons with specific wording in notes

candidates.title: Holds reports set
candidates.statement: The system shall provide holds reports including Holds Purchase Alert, Items Sent for Holds, Items Received for Holds, IntraPINES Loans (for all Systems and Facilities, and by System and Facility), Unfilled Holds, Annual number of holds placed, and Stale Holds (holds on hold shelf waiting for pickup too long).
candidates.source_quote: HOLDS REPORTS: - Holds Purchase Alert - Items Sent for Holds - Items Received for Holds - IntraPINES Loans for all Systems - IntraPINES Loans for all Facilities - IntraPINES Loans by System - IntraPINES Loans by Facility - Unfilled Holds - Annual # of holds placed - Stale Holds (holds sitting on hold shelf waiting for pickup for too long)

candidates.title: In-house use reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide in-house use reports including NonCat In House Use Count by Month and Cataloged In House Use Count.
candidates.source_quote: IN HOUSE USE REPORTS: - NonCat In House Use Count by Month - Cataloged In House Use Count

candidates.title: Transit reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide transit reports including Items In Transit to Destination Library and Items In Transit by Sending Library.
candidates.source_quote: TRANSITS REPORTS: - Items In Transit to Destination Library - Items In Transit by Sending Library

candidates.title: Bills and payments reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide bills reports including Bills currently Owed by Patrons, Detailed Payments Received, Detailed Forgive/Work/Goods Payments Received, Detailed Voids, and Aged Debt.
candidates.source_quote: BILLS REPORTS: - Bills currently Owed by Patrons - Detailed Payments Received - Detailed Forgive, Work, and Goods Payments Received - Detailed Voids - Aged Debt

candidates.title: Three reporting interfaces
candidates.statement: The system shall provide three reporting interfaces: canned reports, non-canned (on-demand) reports, and open-template reporting.
candidates.source_quote: 15.1 Three Interfaces Three interfaces are needed: a) Canned reports ... b) Noncanned or On Demand Reports ... c) Open Template Reporting

candidates.title: Canned reports templates provided
candidates.statement: The system shall include a set of pre-written canned report templates delivered with the product.
candidates.source_quote: There should be a certain set of templates that are pre-written and delivered with the product.
candidates.priority_signals: pre-written and delivered with the product

candidates.title: Canned reports relative date ranges
candidates.statement: The system shall allow canned reports to run using relative date ranges such as yesterday's data, last week's, last month's, or last year's.
candidates.source_quote: Will have the ability for it to run by yesterday's data, last week's, last month's, or last year's.

candidates.title: Batch-run and single-document view for canned reports
candidates.statement: The system shall allow canned reports to be selected from a list to run at the same time and to be viewed combined within a single document.
candidates.source_quote: Canned reports can be checked off from a list to run at the same time and will be viewed within one document.

candidates.title: On-demand reports capability
candidates.statement: The system shall provide on-demand reports that are preset but allow selection for maintenance reports or collections development and can be run on demand.
candidates.source_quote: On Demand Reports would be for pre-selected criteria ... and would be set to run on demand.

candidates.title: Open template reporting attributes
candidates.statement: The system shall provide open-template reporting that exposes all attributes associated with circulation, items, patrons, bills, and bibs for selection as filters and for display.
candidates.source_quote: Open template would have all attributes associated with say circulation, patrons, items, bills, and bibs to select from for filtering and the same attributes for displaying.
